description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindAJob" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PotentialJobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ProbationOffer" name="Probation offer"/>

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_MergeReporting" name="Reporting cycle"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchOffer" name="Potential job offer received">

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchProbation" name="Probation offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchProbation_ED" messageRef="Msg_ProbationOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="A_CompleteProbation" name="Complete probation phase"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="A_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_RateMerge" name="Rating step done"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchPermanent" name="Job made permanent received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchPermanent_ED" messageRef="Msg_JobMadePermanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_RatingDecision" name="Company rated C or less?" default="Flow_A_EndDefault"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_MergeOffers" name="Continue receiving offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="A_CatchOfferContinuing" name="Potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="A_CatchOfferContinuing_ED" messageRef="Msg_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A_ContinueDecision" name="Keep receiving offers?" default="Flow_A_ContinueLoop"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="A_End" name="Job search ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="A_Start" targetRef="A_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="A_SendApplication" targetRef="A_MergeReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="A_MergeReporting" targetRef="A_Report"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="A_Report" targetRef="A_EventGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="A_EventGateway" targetRef="A_CatchOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="A_EventGateway" targetRef="A_CatchProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="A_CatchOffer" targetRef="A_MergeReporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="A_CatchProbation" targetRef="A_CompleteProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="A_CompleteProbation" targetRef="A_RateChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" name="Yes" sourceRef="A_RateChoice" targetRef="A_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_RateSkip" name="No" sourceRef="A_RateChoice" targetRef="A_RateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="A_RateCompany" targetRef="A_RateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="A_RateMerge" targetRef="A_CatchPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="A_CatchPermanent" targetRef="A_RatingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" name="C or less" sourceRef="A_RatingDecision" targetRef="A_MergeOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyRatingCOrLess}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_EndDefault" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="A_RatingDecision" targetRef="A_End"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="A_MergeOffers" targetRef="A_CatchOfferContinuing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="A_CatchOfferContinuing" targetRef="A_ContinueDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" name="Stop receiving offers" sourceRef="A_ContinueDecision" targetRef="A_End">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerSearchStopped}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A_ContinueLoop" name="Continue" sourceRef="A_ContinueDecision" targetRef="A_MergeOffers"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C_Start" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="C_Start_ED" messageRef="Msg_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_InterviewSplit" name="Interview negotiated?" default="Flow_C_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_InterviewMerge" name="Interview decision merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_HireSplit" name="Company wants you to work for them?" default="Flow_C_NoHire"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C_NoHireEnd" name="Application not pursued"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_SendProbation" name="Send probation offer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_ProbationPhase" name="Conduct probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_RateChoice" name="Rate applicant?" default="Flow_C_RateSkip"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C_RateMerge" name="Rating step done"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="C_ParallelSplit" name="Split after rating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C_SendPermanent" name="Confirm job made permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C_EndPermanent" name="Job made permanent"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="C_TimerOneYear" name="Wait one year">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="C_TimerOneYear_ED">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="C_MakeReviewsVisible" name="Make company reviews visible to applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C_EndReviewsVisible" name="Reviews released"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="C_Start" targetRef="C_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="C_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="C_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="C_RateApplication" targetRef="C_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="C_InterviewSplit" targetRef="C_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewNegotiated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NoInterview" name="No interview" sourceRef="C_InterviewSplit" targetRef="C_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="C_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="C_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="C_InterviewMerge" targetRef="C_HireSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" name="Hire" sourceRef="C_HireSplit" targetRef="C_SendProbation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyWantsToHire}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NoHire" name="No hire" sourceRef="C_HireSplit" targetRef="C_NoHireEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="C_SendProbation" targetRef="C_ProbationPhase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="C_ProbationPhase" targetRef="C_RateChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" name="Yes" sourceRef="C_RateChoice" targetRef="C_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_RateSkip" name="No" sourceRef="C_RateChoice" targetRef="C_RateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="C_RateApplicant" targetRef="C_RateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="C_RateMerge" targetRef="C_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="C_ParallelSplit" targetRef="C_SendPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="C_SendPermanent" targetRef="C_EndPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="C_ParallelSplit" targetRef="C_TimerOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="C_TimerOneYear" targetRef="C_MakeReviewsVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="C_MakeReviewsVisible" targetRef="C_EndReviewsVisible"/>
  </bpmn:process>
